name: Foster Care
overview: Scripture calls God's people to care for those without parental protection, emphasizing kindness and justice toward the fatherless and needy. Leviticus instructs believers not to oppress strangers dwelling among them, reflecting a heart of compassion. The Psalms repeatedly affirm God's role as defender and helper of the fatherless and poor, promising justice and salvation for them. Job models a godly example of raising and guiding those in vulnerable positions as a father would, highlighting the responsibility to nurture and protect.
